flatVocabParam.name: strain
flatVocabParam.help: Strain or isolate whose coordinate system the returned segment is expressed in. The list is restricted to strains that have indel data loaded for the selected organism.

sqlQuery.name: StrainsByOrganism
sqlQuery.sql: SELECT strain AS internal, strain AS term, strain AS display FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(pan.name, '_Indel$', '') AS strain FROM apidb.indel i , study.protocolappnode pan , webready.GenomicSeqAttributes_p gsa WHERE pan.protocol_app_node_id = i.protocol_app_node_id AND gsa.na_sequence_id = i.na_sequence_id AND gsa.org_abbrev IN ($$organismSinglePick$$) ) t ORDER BY strain
